q: Who issues a new corporate card to an employee?
answer:
The Office & purchasing desk issues corporate cards. It also cancels and reissues them, and decides temporary limit raises. Reach it at ext. 2210 or through the shared "Office" groupware account.

If a card is lost, stop it with the card issuer first, then tell the desk.

Sources: RouteMind procurement area → Office & purchasing desk (`/v1/nodes/ga-desk/body`, `/v1/nodes/ga-contact/body`).
